name: ray
description: An agentic, evidence-first security review pipeline: 37 composable skills that map a codebase, build a threat model, audit it across security domains (web, memory-safety, AI/LLM, dependencies/SBOM, and infrastructure-as-code), validate, reproduce, and score every finding — plus a live red-team/blue-team loop (ray-siege), external attack-surface recon (ray-quarry), a tiered-autonomy detection-and-response analyst (ray-warden), operational maintenance auditing (ray-steward), a write-time secret-leak guard (ray-cloak), a real-browser product-coherence & QA verifier (ray-vantage), a legal-engineering & compliance layer (ray-counsel: AI transparency, ToS/arbitration, and Apple/Google privacy labels), and a high-precision general code-review skill (ray-loupe) — with agents that keep curated cross-run memory and real bundled tools exposed over MCP. Runs end-to-end through the ray-conductor orchestrator against an immutable, content-hashed snapshot, with every finding validated against a single JSON schema (schema.json) and a static-track patcher (ray-anvil) that only marks a fix VERIFIED_SECURE after a >=3-variant re-attack.
